ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 14-G and 16-G in the
area bound by:

      South Ashland Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West 63 rd Street; South
      Laflin Street; West 63rd Street; a line 182 feet east of and parallel to South Laflin Street;
      the alley next south of and parallel to West 63 rd Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                             ____________________________
                                                             Stephanie D. Coleman
                                                             Alderman, 16h Ward




Common Address:
1443-1547 W. 63rd Street
1500-1546 W. 63rd Street
6247-6301 S. Ashland Avenue
